summary: Full E2E validation of the two new reconnect features (technician-initiated reconnect notification + client-side partilha-interrompida screen). All 5 review-request scenarios pass end-to-end via 2 browser contexts + RTCPeerConnection.addTrack monkey-patch to capture the fake MediaStreamTrack for the 'ended' simulation.

critical_code_review_comments: cliente.js mostrarReconectar() correctly guards with `if (stream) return` to avoid re-triggering during active share.
cliente.js partilhaInterrompida() correctly calls limparRecursos() (which sets stream=null) before showing the reconectar screen, so the guard doesn't block it.

tecnico.js abrirVer() correctly emits tecnico:pedir-reconexao when the target session is not already aPartilhar. Backend @sio.on('tecnico:pedir-reconexao') enforces operator ownership before relaying to the cliente sid — correct auth check.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For 'Partilha interrompida' simulation via getDisplayMedia stub: Playwright's Chromium uses --use-fake-device-for-media-stream so navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia cannot be reliably overridden via add_init_script. Instead, monkey-patch RTCPeerConnection.prototype.addTrack in an init script to capture window.__capturedTrack = track, then in the test call track.stop() + track.dispatchEvent(new Event('ended')). This reliably triggers the 'ended' handler bound in cliente.js:140. To reach the cliente via btn-ver, use the FIRST '#grelha-online button.ver' (newest online session).
rca of the issue: Not a bug this iteration. Verified test results: Test1 (btn-ver on non-sharing) -> cliente reconectar-titulo='Reconectar?' + btn visible. Test2 (btn-pedir-reconexao) -> button text 'Pedido enviado ✓' + cliente still on reconectar. Test3 (cliente clicks reconectar) -> parar-btn visible, tecnico video srcObject=true w=1280 esperaOculto=true. Test4 (track.stop + ended) -> cliente reconectar visible + titulo='Partilha interrompida'. Test5 (regression: click on video-ecra) -> .circulo-toque count=1 on cliente. No 'iceReady is not defined' or 'io is not defined' errors observed.
